sessions.title: Learn extended ACL syntax
sessions.objective: Write extended ACL entries that match protocol, source, destination, and port.

sessions.title: Learn CDP, LLDP, NTP, SNMP, and Syslog
sessions.objective: Explain the purpose of each management protocol and when to use it.

sessions.title: Learn ACL incident response workflow
sessions.objective: Identify the steps to diagnose blocked user access and blocked remote management.

sessions.title: Practice diagnosing ACL-caused outages
sessions.objective: Locate the ACL entry causing a reachability or management failure and correct it.

sessions.title: Learn troubleshooting workflows and layered model
sessions.objective: Apply a structured troubleshooting workflow across the OSI layers.

sessions.title: Practice documenting a troubleshooting result
sessions.objective: Write a concise incident record covering symptom, cause, fix, and verification.

sessions.title: Learn automation concepts and data formats
sessions.objective: Read and compare YAML, JSON, and XML structures and explain REST and DNA Center roles.

sessions.title: Learn REST methods and authentication
sessions.objective: Map CRUD operations to HTTP methods and describe common API authentication.

sessions.title: Practice Postman requests and collections
sessions.objective: Build a Postman collection that retrieves device information with authentication.

sessions.title: Learn API-based diagnostics for support
sessions.objective: Select the API calls needed to gather diagnostics and verify configuration.

sessions.title: Practice verifying configurations with APIs
sessions.objective: Run API queries to confirm a device configuration matches the expected state.

sessions.title: Learn VoIP fundamentals and call flows
sessions.objective: Compare PSTN and VoIP, and trace a SIP call flow with RTP media and QoS needs.

sessions.title: Learn CUCM architecture and endpoints
sessions.objective: Describe CUCM components, endpoint registration, and how dial plans are structured.

sessions.title: Practice partitions and calling search spaces
sessions.objective: Determine whether a call succeeds given partitions and calling search space assignments.

sessions.title: Learn VoIP maintenance and troubleshooting
sessions.objective: Identify causes of dial plan errors, unregistered phones, DHCP option issues, NTP issues, and codec mismatches.

sessions.title: Practice diagnosing VoIP service faults

sessions.title: Review VoIP and CUCM across all topics
